tagline: Build Scalable Web Applications with Modern JavaScript
intro: Master Node.js, Express, MongoDB & Build Production-Ready Full Stack Applications
overview: Node.js is a powerful, open-source JavaScript runtime environment built on Google Chrome’s V8 Engine. It allows developers to create fast, scalable, and highly efficient server-side applications. Node.js is widely used for building modern web applications, APIs, real-time applications, video streaming platforms, and single-page applications (SPAs). This course is designed to take you from zero to job-ready by teaching complete Full Stack Web Development using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and modern tools.

curriculum.title: Module 01: Fundamentals & JavaScript Mastery (Class 01–06)
curriculum.details:
Class 01:
- Introduction to Node.js & Full Stack Development
Class 02:
- JavaScript Basics – Part 1 (Variables, Data Types, Functions)
Class 03:
- JavaScript Basics – Part 2 (ES6+ Features: Arrow Function, Destructuring, Spread, Rest)
Class 04:
- JavaScript Advanced – Part 1 (Array Methods, Object Methods, DOM Basics)
Class 05:
- avaScript Advanced – Part 2 (Async JavaScript, Promises, Fetch API)
Class 06:
- Environment Setup, VS Code, Node.js Installation & NPM

curriculum.title: Module 02: Node.js Core Concepts (Class 07–11)
curriculum.details:
Class 07:
- Node.js Architecture & Event Loop Explained
Class 08:
- Modules System, Core Modules & File System (fs)
Class 09:
- Working with Paths, Streams & Buffers
Class 10:
- Building HTTP Server with Core Node.js
Class 11:
- Introduction to Express.js & First Express Server

curriculum.title: Module 03: Express.js & API Development (Class 12–17)
curriculum.details:
Class 12:
- Express.js Routing & Middleware
Class 13:
- Building RESTful APIs (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Class 14:
- Dynamic Routes & Route Parameters
Class 15:
- Template Engines (EJS) – Dynamic Content Rendering
Class 16:
- MVC Architecture Pattern Implementation
Class 17:
- Advanced Controllers & Error Handling in Express

curriculum.title: Module 04: Database Integration (Class 18–23)
curriculum.details:
Class 18:
- Introduction to Databases – SQL vs NoSQL
Class 19:
- MongoDB Installation & Basic CRUD Operations
Class 20:
- Working with MongoDB Compass & Advanced Queries
Class 21:
- Introduction to Mongoose ODM
Class 22:
- Mongoose Schema, Models & Relationships
Class 23:
- Advanced Mongoose Features (Populate, Validation, Middleware)

curriculum.title: Module 05: Authentication & Security (Class 24–27)
curriculum.details:
Class 24:
- Sessions & Cookies Management
Class 25:
- User Registration & Login System
Class 26:
- Authentication with JWT (JSON Web Token)
Class 27:
- Password Hashing, Authorization & Protected Routes

curriculum.title: Module 06: Advanced Features & Production (Class 28–32)
curriculum.details:
Class 28:
- Sending Emails (Nodemailer) & File Upload
Class 29:
- Data Validation, Sanitization & Error Handling
Class 30:
- Pagination, Filtering & Search Functionality
Class 31:
- Testing Node.js Applications (Jest & Supertest)
Class 32:
- Deployment (Render / Vercel / Railway) + Final Project Presentation
